meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'деяться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hope, to rely on', paired with 'понадеяться'.

examples.trans: I hope so. Go on, act quickly!

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'find'.

examples.text: Ну где я сейчас найду грузчиков?
examples.trans: Well, where am I going to find movers right now?

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

Prefix 'во-' ('into, up') marks inward or upward movement (stem 'лноваться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to worry'.
